description: Co-parenting and co-habitation matchmaking platform for single mothers. Stack: Next.js frontend, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Functions, Storage, FCM) backend, Elasticsearch on a low-cost VPS for matching.

tasks.title: MVP waitlist landing page
requirements: Build a public landing page (route `/`) that describes Parade's purpose for single mothers in Ontario seeking co-parenting and co-habitation matches.
The landing page is the only public surface: it must allow registration (join the waitlist) and nothing else — no discovery, matching, messaging, or profile features are reachable.
Include a clear value proposition, how-it-works summary, and a prominent call-to-action to join the waitlist.
Be fully responsive and accessible (semantic landmarks, keyboard navigable, WCAG AA contrast).
Include SEO metadata (title, description, Open Graph/Twitter cards) and a shareable canonical URL.
Preserve the existing static-export build (`output: "export"`) and pass typecheck, lint, and build.

tasks.title: Ontario waitlist signup with community selection
requirements: Provide a waitlist signup form reachable from the landing page that captures name, email, and community.

Community is a required combo box (typeahead + dropdown) populated from a canonical list of major Ontario regions/communities (e.g. Toronto, Peel, York, Durham, Halton, Hamilton, Ottawa, Waterloo, London, Windsor, Niagara, Simcoe/Muskoka, Kingston, Sudbury, Thunder Bay).
Validate all inputs client-side (valid email, non-empty name, community must be one of the canonical options) and surface clear inline errors.
Persist signups to Firestore in a `waitlist` collection with normalized community id, timestamp, and source/referral metadata; never store secrets client-side.
Enforce Firestore security rules so waitlist documents are write-only from the client and not publicly readable.
Prevent duplicate signups for the same email and show a friendly confirmation state after submission.
Cover the form and validation logic with component/unit tests.

tasks.title: Community signup leaderboard and share link
requirements: After a successful waitlist signup, show a leaderboard of Ontario communities ranked by total signup counts.
Highlight the community the user selected and show its current rank and count.
Provide a share link (with referral/community attribution) and social share actions (e.g. X/Twitter, Facebook, WhatsApp, copy link) so users can invite others.
Aggregate counts server-side (Firestore aggregation or a scheduled/triggered Cloud Function) so the client never reads the full waitlist collection.
Expose a read-only public endpoint/collection for aggregate counts that does not leak individual signup data.
Handle empty/loading/error states and keep the leaderboard responsive on mobile.
Cover the leaderboard rendering and share-link generation with tests.

tasks.title: Provision Firebase project and environments
requirements: Create Firebase project on the Blaze plan with dev and prod environments.
Enable Firebase Auth, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Messaging.
Pin all services to a single region to minimize latency and cold-start cost.
Store project config in environment variables; never commit secrets.
Document project ids and regions in the repo.

tasks.title: Stand up Elasticsearch on a low-cost VPS
requirements: Provision a Hetzner CX22 (or equivalent ~2GB RAM) VPS.
Run Elasticsearch via Docker Compose with persistent volume.
Secure with TLS, authentication, and firewall rules restricting access to Firebase Functions egress.
Expose a health endpoint and document connection details.
Provide a docker-compose.yml and setup script in the repo.

tasks.title: Configure domain and SSL
requirements: Register or delegate the production domain.
Point DNS to the Next.js hosting target (e.g. Firebase Hosting or Vercel).
Provision and auto-renew TLS certificates.
Force HTTPS and configure HSTS.
Document DNS records in the repo.

tasks.title: Bootstrap Next.js frontend
requirements: Scaffold a Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript project.
Configure linting, formatting, and strict TypeScript.
Add Firebase client SDK and initialize the app from environment config.
Set up base layout, routing, and a shared UI component library.
Add a CI check that builds the app.

tasks.title: User registration (email/password + OAuth)
requirements: Implement email/password sign-up and sign-in using Firebase Auth.
Support at least one OAuth provider (Google and/or Apple).
Validate inputs client-side and surface clear error messages.
Create a user profile document on first sign-up.
Cover the flow with component tests.

tasks.title: Email verification flow
requirements: Send a verification email on registration via Firebase Auth.
Gate protected routes until the email is verified.
Provide a resend-verification action with rate limiting.
Show clear status messaging to the user.
tasks.notes: Implemented on top of the existing Firebase Auth workflow. lib/auth.ts gained sendVerificationEmail (with a 60s per-user client-side cooldown and VerificationRateLimitError), getVerificationResendCooldown, reloadUser, subscribeToIdTokenChanges, and verification-specific error mappings. AuthProvider now exposes emailVerified + reloadUser and auto-detects verification via onIdTokenChanged plus a 5s poll and focus/visibility reload while unverified. Registration sends the verification email and redirects unverified users to /verify-email. New /verify-email page shows status messaging, a resend action with a live countdown, and a manual check button. Protected routes are gated by the new RequireVerifiedEmail guard applied via the (app) route-group layout; the home page moved into (app). NavBar surfaces a 'Verify email' link for unverified users. Firebase Auth remains the source of truth for emailVerified (no Firestore write needed). Covered by 50 passing tests (unit + component); typecheck, lint, and static export build all pass.

tasks.title: Identity verification (ID upload + background check)
requirements: Allow users to upload government ID to Firebase Storage with signed URLs.
Integrate a background-check provider (e.g. Checkr/Persona) via a Firebase Function.
Store verification status on the user document; never store raw ID data in Firestore.
Enforce retention and deletion policy for uploaded documents.
Expose verification status in the UI.

tasks.title: IP geofencing for non-local flagging
requirements: Resolve client IP to a coarse geographic region on sign-in.
Flag users connecting from outside the community region as non-local.
Store the flag on the user document without storing precise location.
Document privacy implications and allow user appeal.

tasks.title: Password reset flow
requirements: Implement forgot-password request using Firebase Auth.
Send a reset email with a secure, expiring link.
Provide a reset-password page that validates the code and updates the password.
Rate-limit reset requests to prevent abuse.

tasks.title: Account deletion and data privacy controls
requirements: Allow users to request account deletion from settings.
Delete or anonymize all personal data across Firestore, Storage, and Elasticsearch.
Provide a data export (GDPR-style) endpoint.
Confirm deletion via email and log the action for audit.

tasks.title: Multi-step profile creation wizard
requirements: Build a quick, painless multi-step wizard with progress indication.
Persist partial progress so users can resume.
Validate each step before allowing progression.
Submit the completed profile to Firestore.

tasks.title: Design profile schema for fuzzy matching
requirements: Define the Firestore profile document schema as the source of truth.
Define the corresponding Elasticsearch index mapping optimized for fuzzy matching.
Specify analyzers and fields for location, rent range, lifestyle, children, and pets.
Version the schema and document migration strategy.

tasks.title: Personal details capture (name, age, location, photo)
requirements: Capture name, age, and location with validation.
Support photo upload to Firebase Storage with client-side resizing.
Enforce content moderation/safety scanning on uploads.
Display a profile preview.

tasks.title: Housing preference and target rent
requirements: Capture whether the user is seeking shared accommodation or offering accommodation.
Capture target rent amount and currency.
Validate ranges and store on the profile document.
Reflect these fields in the Elasticsearch mapping.

tasks.title: Lifestyle preferences capture
requirements: Capture comfort with male visitors, smoking, and drinking.
Use consistent enumerated values shared with the matching schema.
Store on the profile document and index in Elasticsearch.

tasks.title: Children and pets details
requirements: Capture number of children and their ages.
Capture current pets and types.
Validate inputs and store on the profile document.
Index these fields for matching.

tasks.title: Search and filter interface
requirements: Build a search/filter UI for location, age range, children ages, and lifestyle preferences.
Debounce queries and show loading states.
Support pagination or infinite scroll.
Persist filter state in the URL.

tasks.title: Swipe or browse-style profile discovery
requirements: Implement swipe or browse discovery with smooth interactions.
Preload the next profiles for responsiveness.
Handle empty and error states gracefully.
Be responsive on mobile and desktop.

tasks.title: Compatibility scoring algorithm
requirements: Implement a compatibility score based on preferences and values.
Use Elasticsearch fuzzy matching for candidate retrieval.
Weight location, rent range, lifestyle, children, and pets.
Expose the score and contributing factors for transparency.

tasks.title: Saved searches and new-match notifications
requirements: Allow users to save search criteria.
Notify users when new profiles match a saved search.
Use Firebase Cloud Messaging for push and email fallback.
Allow managing and deleting saved searches.

tasks.title: Like / Pass interaction tracking
requirements: Record like and pass interactions in Firestore.
Prevent duplicate interactions and support undo where appropriate.
Feed interactions into the matching algorithm.
Persist across sessions.

tasks.title: Mutual match detection and notification
requirements: Detect mutual likes via a Firestore trigger.
Create a match record and notify both users.
Send push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Surface matches in a dedicated view.

tasks.title: Block and report functionality
requirements: Allow users to block and report other profiles.
Exclude blocked users from search and discovery.
Route reports to a moderation queue.
Confirm actions and allow unblocking.

tasks.title: Real-time chat via Firestore listeners
requirements: Implement real-time messaging using Firestore onSnapshot listeners.
Use the conversations/messages data model defined in the README.
Enforce security rules so only participants can read/write.
Handle reconnection and offline states.

tasks.title: Message inbox with previews and unread counts
requirements: Query conversations where participants contains the current uid.
Order by last message timestamp descending.
Show last-message preview and per-participant unread counts.
Update in real time.

tasks.title: Conversation threading and read receipts
requirements: Group messages into threaded conversations.
Implement read receipts and typing indicators.
Mark messages read on view and update unread counts.
Keep the UI responsive under rapid updates.

tasks.title: Media sharing with safety scanning
requirements: Allow sharing images and documents via Firebase Storage.
Scan uploads for unsafe content before delivery.
Generate signed URLs and enforce access control.
Show upload progress and handle failures.

tasks.title: Message reporting and blocking in conversations
requirements: Allow reporting messages and blocking users from within a conversation.
Route reports to the moderation queue.
Immediately hide blocked users' messages.
Confirm actions to the user.

tasks.title: Push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging
requirements: Register device tokens and store them per user.
Send push notifications for new messages and matches.
Respect user notification preferences.
Handle token refresh and cleanup.

tasks.title: Optional icebreaker prompts
requirements: Offer optional icebreaker prompts to start conversations.
Allow inserting a prompt as the first message.
Keep prompts configurable and non-intrusive.
Track usage for product insight.

tasks.title: Firestore to Elasticsearch sync functions
requirements: Implement onCreate/onUpdate Firestore triggers that sync profiles to Elasticsearch.
Make handlers idempotent and retry-safe.
Batch external calls and use 2nd gen functions with region pinning.
Keep bundles small to reduce cold starts.
Add structured logging and error alerting.

tasks.title: Functions performance and cost guardrails
requirements: Keep functions small, event-driven, and single-purpose.
Use 2nd gen functions and pin regions consistently.
Minimize cold starts via small bundles and lazy initialization.
Monitor invocation counts and Firestore read/write volume.
Document cost guardrails and alert thresholds.
